items.basis: the claimed mechanism requires the static field to alter CaCO3 nucleation kinetics, but every species in this water (H2O, Ca2+, HCO3-, CO3 2-) is diamagnetic with closed shells; the field-ion interaction energy is roughly χm·B²/(2μ0·NA) ≈ (1e-6 m³/mol)(0.9 T)²/(2·4πe-7·6.02e23) ≈ 5e-25 J per ion, versus thermal energy kT ≈ 4.3e-21 J at 35 C — the field perturbation is about four orders of magnitude below Brownian thermal energy, so it cannot shift crystallization kinetics by any physically causal route; the claimed 90% effect has no energy source GROUNDED_IN: COMPUTATION 5e-25 J field interact
